description: This file defines a Timer class for managing millisecond timers using pthreads, including exception handling, message queue management, and callback mechanisms.

classes.name: TimerException
classes.description: Exception class for timer-related errors, derived from std::exception.

classes.name: Timer
classes.description: A class implementing a millisecond timer based on pthreads, supporting callback functions, message queue, and thread management.

methods.name: Timer
methods.description: Constructor for Timer class, initializes callback, user data, and timer name.

methods.name: ~Timer
methods.description: Destructor for Timer class, cleans up resources.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels the active timer, preventing callback execution.

methods.name: arm
methods.description: Arms the timer for a specified timeout in milliseconds.

methods.name: createArmMessage
methods.description: Creates a new message to arm the timer with a specified timeout.

methods.name: createCancelMessage
methods.description: Creates a new message to cancel the timer.

methods.name: createQuitMessage
methods.description: Creates a new message to quit the timer thread.

methods.name: timerThreadFunction
methods.description: Static function serving as the thread entry point for the timer thread.

methods.name: timerThread
methods.description: Main loop of the timer thread, processing message queue.

methods.name: postTimerMessage
methods.description: Posts a message to the timer thread's message queue, optionally urgent.
